algorithm: 3D Diffusion Policy (DP3) for xArm platforms; ACT for H1 humanoid (downstream IL); IK-based scale/recenter end-effector mapping + AnyTeleop fingertip-vector hand retargeting
hand: Ability Hand / Inspire Hand / parallel-jaw gripper (embodiment-dependent)
arm: xArm7 / H1 humanoid / B1 quadruped+Z1 / Franka / GR-1 humanoid (five embodiments)
success_criterion: target-reaching task: "success was recorded when both end-effectors reached their respective target area and remained within the target regions for a short duration"
headline_metric: sub-task success rate (10 episodes/task, real robot)
headline_value: Table 2 (simulated target-reaching, small workspace/small target): ACE 97.1% success vs. GELLO 47.6%; Table 3 (real robot, 10 episodes/task): Grasp Dolls (xArm) Grasp 0.9/Place 0.8; Vacuum Keyboard Grasp 1/Activate 0.6/Clean 0.6/Place 0.5
note_gaps: the end-effector control-mapping equation (Sec. 3.2, Eq. 1), the App. C "inside-target" formula, and the hand-retargeting cost equation (Appendix B, reused from AnyTeleop) are all unrecovered images
operator_interface: visual exoskeleton: 3D-printed bimanual 6-DoF-per-arm exoskeleton with wrist-mounted cameras for MediaPipe finger tracking; not a glove or VR headset
retargeting_objective: wrist/end-effector pose mapped via a scale-and-recenter IK transform (Normal/Mirror/Bimanual modes) from exoskeleton forward kinematics; finger joints retargeted via AnyTeleop's fingertip-keypoint-vector optimization with joint limits and temporal smoothing
latency: 27 Hz hand tracking; no end-to-end figure
